title: Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: Tender and flavorful kebabs made with marinated chicken, perfect for a delicious and easy meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the kebabs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the kebabs with olive oil.
Bake the kebabs in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.
